issue.title: Hardcoded values in client.lua should be configurable
issue.body:
### Summary Several magic numbers are hardcoded directly in `client.lua`, making it difficult to tune behavior without modifying the source file. These values should be exposed through a central config. ### Reproduction 1. Open `client/client.lua` 2. Search for literal numbers such as `650`, `950.0`, `850.0`, `-25.0`, `50.0`, `1000`, `5000`, `25`, `5`, `50` 3. Notice they are scattered across multiple event handlers with no single place to change them 4. Any tuning (e.g. adjusting fade duration or teleport Z-search range) requires editing core source code directly ### Expected behavior `All tuneable constants should be defined in a config.lua so server owners and contributors can adjust values without touching core logic.
Constant Current Value Location
Screen fade duration650 msGoToMarker
Z search start950.0GoToMarker
Z search step-25.0GoToMarker
Scene load radius50.0GoToMarker
Collision timeout1000 msGoToMarker
/me display duration5000 msme state bag handler
/me max distance25 unitsme state bag handler
Default vehicle radius5 unitsgetVehiclesInRadius
setVehicleProperties timeout1000 mssetVehicleProperties
setVehicleProperties wait tick50 mssetVehicleProperties
Seat indices for clear peds{-1, 0}initVehicle handler
` ### Actual behavior All tuneable constants are hardcoded directly in client.lua, making it impossible to adjust behavior without modifying core source code directly ### Additional context _No response_ ### Current Version v1.3.0 ### Custom Resources none
